system: Interpret a refinement of an existing video brief as explicit typed updates. Preserve every prior asset locator/hash, observed evidence, fixed dialogue, onscreen words, target, role and constraint unless the new instruction expressly authorizes changing that field. Never replace the original request by merely concatenating the new instruction. For intent, return the complete revised intent preserving every unaffected requirement. Do not rewrite observations or Asset.Description to simulate a target appearance change: express the target change in intent. New media cannot be invented or fetched; ask for an explicitly supplied resource through a caller-visible failure. Each update must quote the exact portion of the NEW instruction that authorizes it. Empty asset_id denotes a Brief field; asset_role, asset_replaces and asset_remove identify an existing asset. set supplies a correctly typed JSON value, clear removes an optional value, asset_remove uses remove. Do not remove an asset or dialogue merely because it is omitted from the edit request. Dialogue values use the public Dialogue shape and preserve exact new words. Explicit transcript_uses, subject_projections and replacement_targets are independently editable fields. Preserve fixed selected performances and source identities unless the new instruction authorizes changing them. Removing a selected source requires an explicit update/clear of the dependent choice in the same patch; never delete its performance merely to make the asset removal compile. New explicit subject selectors identify the amended graph; unchanged selectors are mechanically remapped by the host to their same observed source identity. Return only the schema.

input.change: Change the rendering style to watercolour storybook. Preserve both exact first and last frames, all supplied assets, eight-second duration and other caller choices.

previous_brief.intent: Start with the first supplied picture exactly and end on the second supplied picture exactly. Between those endpoints the scene transforms with a slow visual dissolve. Preserve the complete pixels of both endpoint pictures.

facts.text: The image is a vertical character reference sheet: a cinematic hero image occupies the top section; below it are three full-body studio panels labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK, followed by four detail panels labeled FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.

The hero panel shows an adult person standing upright on a wet, reflective industrial walkway or rooftop at night, with rain falling, metal railings, blurred city lights, and warm amber light from a building on the right.
The person has short dark hair with shaved sides and a longer top pulled back, medium-light skin, and a visible diagonal scar near one eyebrow.
The person wears a black collared utility jacket over a dark shirt, black cargo-style trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
In the hero image the person stands with arms at their sides, head turned toward the viewer's left, with a neutral, serious expression.
The middle FRONT panel shows the same person facing the camera in a full-body studio view against a dark gray backdrop.
The SIDE PROFILE panel shows the person in profile facing the viewer's left, and the BACK panel shows the rear view of the jacket, trousers, and boots.
The FACE detail panel is a close crop of the person's face, showing the undercut hairstyle, neutral expression, and scar near the eyebrow.
The JACKET COLLAR detail shows black fabric, a strap, and a metal buckle; the HANDS detail shows weathered hands with visible veins; the BOOTS detail shows worn black leather lace-up combat boots.
The studio panels use dim, soft directional lighting against a dark gray background, while the hero panel uses cool blue night ambience contrasted with warm amber practical lights.

limitations: The hero panel is dark and rainy, obscuring some fine background and clothing texture.
The detail panels are cropped views and do not show the full body or every side of the clothing.

card.summary: A dark-fantasy dragon character reference sheet: one large cinematic panel of a black, spiked, winged dragon in a volcanic landscape, plus seven labeled orthographic and detail panels (front, side profile, rear, head close, wing membrane, claw and foot, scale detail).

subjects.descriptor: Large black dragon with pale ridged horns, spiked spine and membranous wings

two long pale ridged horns swept back from the skull
row of dorsal spikes extending along the neck, back and long tail
large dark leathery membranous wings with visible fingers and tattered edges
four legs with pale curved talons
pose: hero panel: standing on rock, body in profile facing left, head lowered
front panel: standing square facing viewer, wings spread
side profile panel: crouched profile facing left
rear panel: standing facing away, wings spread

subjects.descriptor: Volcanic rocky terrain with haze and glowing lava

card.environment: Dark hazy volcanic landscape with jagged rocks, mist and glowing orange lava; detail panels on a plain dark gray studio backdrop
card.lighting: Low-key, moody lighting with cool blue-gray ambient haze in the hero panel; flat, even neutral lighting in the detail panels
card.framing: Hero image across the top; two rows of smaller panels below, with centered captions under each panel
card.style: Photorealistic dark-fantasy creature concept art / turnaround reference sheet
card.characterisation: Sleek, menacing dark dragon with iridescent black armor-like scales, long swept-back horns and tattered membranous wings

facts.text: The image is a multi-panel character reference sheet for a single dark dragon design, with one large hero panel along the top and seven smaller labeled detail panels arranged in two rows below.
The hero panel shows a large quadrupedal dragon standing on dark, wet volcanic rock, its body in profile facing left with the head lowered.
The dragon is covered in glossy black, heavily plated scales with subtle blue-teal iridescence, and has a row of spikes running along its spine and long tail.
Two long, pale, ridged horns sweep back from the crown of the head, with smaller horns and spikes around the jaw and neck.
The dragon's wings are large, dark and membranous with visible fingers and a tattered, leathery trailing edge, partially spread and folded above the back.
The hero panel background is a dark, hazy volcanic landscape with jagged rock formations, mist, and glowing orange lava or embers near the ground on the right.
Four panels in the middle row show the dragon from the front, side profile prior, and rear, each against a plain dark gray background.
Four detail panels in the bottom row show, left to right, the head close-up, a wing membrane, a clawed foot, and a close-up of the scale texture.
The head close-up panel shows a narrow amber-yellow eye, dark facial scales and the ridged pale horns emerging above the brow.
The claw and foot panel shows thick scaled toes ending in long, curved, pale bone-colored talons.
Visible panel captions read: FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, REAR, HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, SCALE DETAIL.

limitations: Small panel captions are legible but the very fine scale texture and background details are only partially resolvable at this resolution.
The image is a still reference sheet; no motion, sound or dialogue can be observed.
